data.gender_notes: Naahil is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A stream, or a mole (in the face)
data.long_meaning: Naahil is an Arabic name derived from the word 'naahil', which refers to a stream or a mole (a small growth on the face). The name Naahil carries the meaning “A stream, or a mole (in the face)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Naahil usually hope their child will grow to embody a stream, or a mole (in the face) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Those bearing this name are believed to be guided by spirituality and inner wisdom, while maintaining a strong connection with nature and life's simple pleasures.
data.etymology: Naahil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A stream, or a mole (in the face).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naahil total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
